# Load libraries

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(DESeq2)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(tximport)
library(apeglm)
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(pheatmap)
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(readxl)
library(CellChat)
```



# Read in the data for GSE119794

```{r, include=FALSE}
pdac_tumour_RNAseq <- read_excel("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/data/data_tumours/tumours_bulk_RNAseq/GSE119794_raw_counts_PDAC_tumours.xlsx")
```



# Filter low counts

```{r, include=FALSE}
pdac_tumour_RNAseq <- pdac_tumour_RNAseq[which(rowSums(pdac_tumour_RNAseq) > 10),]
```



# Convert to matrix

```{r, include=FALSE}
pdac_tumour_mat <- as.matrix(pdac_tumour_RNAseq[,-1])

rownames(pdac_tumour_mat) <- pdac_tumour_RNAseq[[1]]
```



# Make vector describing the experimental conditions and add to metadata (Sample Table)

```{r, include=FALSE}
samples <- colnames(pdac_tumour_mat)

# Extract the condition (pancreas vs tumour) from the suffix
condition <- ifelse(grepl("_pancreas$", samples), "pancreas", "tumour")
condition <- factor(condition, levels = c("pancreas", "tumour"))

# Extract the sample IDs (P01, P02, etc.) from the beginning
sample_id <- sub("_.*$", "", samples)

# Build the sample table
sample_table <- data.frame(
  sample_id = sample_id,
  sample_name = samples,
  condition = condition
)
```



# Filter out low counts by condition

```{r, include=FALSE}
pdac_tumour_RNAseq <- pdac_tumour_RNAseq[
  rowSums(pdac_tumour_RNAseq[, sample_table$sample_name[sample_table$condition == "pancreas"]] >= 5) >= 2 |
  rowSums(pdac_tumour_RNAseq[, sample_table$sample_name[sample_table$condition == "tumour"]] >= 5) >= 2,
]
```



# Create DESeqDataSet object

```{r, include=FALSE}
pdac_tumour_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = pdac_tumour_mat, colData = sample_table, design = ~condition)

pdac_tumour_dds <- DESeq(pdac_tumour_dds)
```



# Regularized log transform of counts

```{r, include=FALSE}
pdac_tumour_rlog <- rlog(pdac_tumour_dds)
```



# Quality check

## Plot PCA

```{r}
plotPCA(pdac_tumour_rlog, intgroup = "condition")
```


## Plot dispersion estimate

```{r}
plotDispEsts(pdac_tumour_dds)
```


## Hierarchical clustering

```{r}
hc_colours <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(9, "Blues")))(255)
sampleDists <- dist(t(assay(pdac_tumour_rlog)))
sdm <- as.matrix(sampleDists)
rownames(sdm) <- colData(pdac_tumour_rlog)$sample_name
colnames(sdm) <- colData(pdac_tumour_rlog)$sample_name
```

### Clustered

```{r, include=FALSE}
pheatmap(sdm, color = hc_colours, border_color = NA, legend = TRUE)
```

### Sample order

```{r}
pheatmap(sdm, color = hc_colours, border_color = NA, legend = TRUE, cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE)
```



# Remove unused objects from the environment

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(pdac_tumour_RNAseq, pdac_tumour_rlog, pdac_tumour_mat, sample_table, sdm, hc_colours, sampleDists)
```



# Differentially expressed genes

```{r, include=FALSE}
pdac_tumour_results <- results(pdac_tumour_dds, contrast = c("condition", "tumour", "pancreas"), alpha = 0.05)

pdac_tumour_results <- lfcShrink(pdac_tumour_dds, coef = "condition_tumour_vs_pancreas", res = pdac_tumour_results, type = "apeglm")
```


## Change geneIDs to gene names

```{r, include=FALSE}
pdac_tumour_results$symbol <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = rownames(pdac_tumour_results), keytype = "ENTREZID", column = "SYMBOL", multiVals = "first")

pdac_tumour_results$symbol[is.na(pdac_tumour_results$symbol)] <- rownames(pdac_tumour_results)[is.na(pdac_tumour_results$symbol)]

rownames(pdac_tumour_results) <- pdac_tumour_results$symbol
```


## Filter for padj < 0.05 and log2FoldChange > 0.2

```{r, include=FALSE}
pdac_tumour_results_df <- as.data.frame(pdac_tumour_results)

pdac_tumour_deg_up <- pdac_tumour_results_df[
  pdac_tumour_results_df$padj < 0.05 & 
  pdac_tumour_results_df$log2FoldChange > 0.2, 
]

pdac_tumour_deg_up <- pdac_tumour_deg_up[ 
  !is.na(pdac_tumour_deg_up$padj) & 
  !is.na(pdac_tumour_deg_up$log2FoldChange), 
]
```


## Export DEGs upregulated in tumours

```{r, include=FALSE}
write.csv(pdac_tumour_deg_up, file = "pdac_tumour_up.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```



# Filter upregulated genes for secreted proteins from the Human Protein Atlas

## Filter secreted protein list from HPA
### NOTE - I downloaded a list of HPA.

```{r, include=FALSE}
hpa <- read.delim("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/proteinatlas.tsv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

hpa_secreted <- hpa[grepl("Secreted proteins|Predicted secreted proteins", hpa$Protein.class), ]

# Human secreted gene list
hpa_secreted_genes <- hpa_secreted$Ensembl
```


## Add ENSEMBL IDs to pdac_tumour_deg_up

```{r, include=FALSE}
pdac_tumour_deg_up$ensembl <- mapIds(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = pdac_tumour_deg_up$symbol,
  column = "ENSEMBL",
  keytype = "SYMBOL",
  multiVals = "first"
)
```


## Filter pdac_tumour_deg_up for secreted genes

```{r, include=FALSE}
pdac_tumour_secreted <- pdac_tumour_deg_up[pdac_tumour_deg_up$ensembl %in% hpa_secreted_genes, ]
```


## Get a list of the genes that are secreted

```{r, include=FALSE}
pdac_tumour_secreted_genes <- pdac_tumour_secreted$symbol

write.table(pdac_tumour_secreted_genes, 
            file = "PDAC_secreted_genes.csv", 
            row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = FALSE,
            quote = FALSE) 
```


## Get list of matching receptors for secreted genes

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Load the built-in human ligand-receptor database
CellChatDB <- CellChatDB.human

# Subset the interactions table for ligands in your secreted gene list
lr_PDAC <- subset(CellChatDB$interaction, ligand %in% pdac_tumour_secreted_genes)

# Extract receptors that line up with secreted genes
pdac_receptors <- unique(trimws(unlist(strsplit(lr_PDAC$receptor.symbol, ","))))
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
write.table(pdac_receptors, 
            file = "PDAC_secreted_genes_receptors.csv", 
            row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = FALSE,
            quote = FALSE) 
```
